subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt this folder-backed encrypted snapshot backup flow after the security and proof blockers are fixed, or should the PR pause in favor of a narrower backup lifecycle design?
rationale: The PR adds a new core backup/storage/config and restore model with security-sensitive behavior, so automation cannot choose the permanent product boundary or acceptable upgrade contract.

options.title: Continue as a core backup candidate
options.body: Keep the PR open but require a maintainer-led rebase, security hardening, upgrade tests, and current real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to archive restore only
options.body: Ask the author to split out the smallest restore or alias improvements and leave folder-backed encrypted snapshots for a separate design issue.

options.title: Pause in favor of canonical backup design
options.body: Close or supersede this branch if maintainers want issue #13616 or another design path to own the backup lifecycle instead.

recommendation.title: Continue as a core backup candidate
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open but require a maintainer-led rebase, security hardening, upgrade tests, and current real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing signal for the original backup CLI lifecycle direction and whether this expansion belongs in core.
